value.content: {"cve_id": "CVE-2023-34362", "software": "Progress MOVEit Transfer", "cvss": 9.8, "vulnerability_type": "SQL_INJECTION", "cwe": "CWE-89", "affected_versions": "Before 2021.0.6, 2021.1.4, 2022.0.4, 2022.1.5, 2023.0.1", "architecture_root_cause": "The web application improperly handled database queries in human.aspx via user-controlled HTTP request headers (specifically the X-siLock-Session-Info header or guestaccess.aspx parameters) which were directly concatenated into dynamic SQL queries without parameterized binding.", "detection_signals": ["moveit_transfer_login", "human.aspx", "guestaccess.aspx", "custom_header_processing", "database_query_header_leak"], "verification_strategy": "Send controlled, non-destructive probe verifying whether custom session header values alter database lookup behavior or generate differential response timing.", "evidence_requirements": ["header_influence_differential", "unauthenticated_response_anomaly_hash"], "remediation": "Apply vendor security patch; replace dynamic string interpolation in session handling with strongly-typed parameterized prepared statements; enforce strict header sanitization."}
